mycc_p_cccc_collab.name: MYCC × Cross Campus Climate Coalition collaboration
mycc_p_cccc_collab.description: MYCC and the Cross Campus Climate Coalition (CCCC) are collaborating this year to strengthen member organizations, learn from each other and build collective power for local politics. Interested organizations sign up through the form.

projects.name: Advocacy Day preparation: meet your state legislators
projects.description: MYCC holds a yearly youth Advocacy Day at the Massachusetts State House; sign-ups are posted on MYCC's Linktree. Before the next one, member groups are asked to meet their local state legislators and start building relationships.

actions.name: Join MYCC: member interest form
actions.description: Youth-led groups in Massachusetts (generally ages 14–22) and their adult staff can join MYCC at three levels: Member (name a point person and bring members to at least one big event: Lobby Day, Rally or Summit), Steering Committee (a Member that also helps lead, meeting every other Tuesday), or Supporter (endorse key documents; good for adult-led groups). Individuals can fill it out too, and it isn't a binding commitment.
